title: synthesis result.json contract
description: Complete contract for <module>/Design/synthesis/result.json. On status=pass, stage_specific.ppa_actual carries area and timing_slack (one record each; power_mw lives in power-analysis, not synthesis). On status=fail, stage_specific.fail_reason is required (if/then below): the one-line cause, which on a run that produced nothing gradeable is all there is. Carrying violations[] obliges ppa_actual with it (dependentRequired), so the gate's judgement never travels without the measurements behind it; an early fail carries neither, because no gate ran.

fix_owner.description: On status=fail: the rule that must act, named by this stage from what it read in the raw tool output. Deliberately NOT an enum — the derived input closure in rules.py is the only authority on which names are legal, and decide checks it there. Naming this stage itself (its in-stage remedy is exhausted) or naming nobody both mean a human decides.

violations.description: PPA violations when status=fail. Lists each target not met.
